name: Vitigo Bee Venom Treatment Cream | Natural Skin Repair Hydration Relief Anti-Irritation
description:
Unlock the benefits of bee venom with Vitigo Bee Venom Treatment Cream, a natural skincare solution that restores, hydrates, and soothes. Enriched with skin-repairing ingredients, it stimulates collagen production, reduces redness, and relieves itching or irritation. Its moisturizing formula deeply nourishes the skin, helping improve uneven tone and texture while leaving it smooth and refreshed. Gentle enough for sensitive skin, it’s perfect for daily use.
Key Features
 Promotes skin repair with natural bee venom
 Encourages collagen production for improved elasticity
 Provides deep hydration and moisture balance
 Reduces redness, itching, and irritation
 Suitable for uneven tone and blemished skin
 Gentle formula safe for sensitive areas
Ingredients / Materials
Bee Venom Extract, Hydrating Agents, Collagen-Boosting Complex, Natural Soothing Botanicals
How to Use
 Cleanse the affected skin area before application
 Apply a small amount of cream evenly
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use twice daily for best results
Package Includes
 1 × Vitigo Bee Venom Treatment Cream
